wiki.title: Alan Morgan (politician)
wiki.extract: Timothy Alan Morgan Jr. (born February 8, 1988) is an American politician. He is a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from the 18th District. He was elected in a special election on May 24, 2022, and was sworn in on June 15, 2022. He was re-elected to office on November 8, 2022. He is a member of the Republican party.
